headline: Colombian Government Proposes Wealth Tax Elimination by 2031
summary: The Colombian government proposed that the wealth tax would be levied only between 2027 and 2030 for fortunes exceeding 95,500 UVT, effectively disappearing by 2031 with fewer people required to pay it.
why: Tax policy proposals regarding wealth and asset levies impact long-term capital retention, high-net-worth investment planning, and fiscal revenue projections.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Changes to wealth tax legislation affect fiscal policy and capital investment behavior.
